plan: Copy appointment records and initialize the four-field public session.
Centralize prompt and screen construction so choice visibility is deterministic.
Validate each action completely before applying state changes.
Keep console input/output replaceable through read_action() and display() collaborators.
mechanisms: Transactional action validation prevents malformed actions from changing session data.
A single state-derived prompt helper implements the check-in state machine.
Fresh screen and choice dictionaries prevent callers from mutating internal appointment data.
Dependency-injected source and sink objects keep run_once() compatible with standard-library unittest fakes.
